scripts.copy-output: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); function copyDir(src, dest) { if (!fs.existsSync(dest)) fs.mkdirSync(dest, { recursive: true }); const entries = fs.readdirSync(src, { withFileTypes: true }); for (const entry of entries) { const srcPath = path.join(src, entry.name); const destPath = path.join(dest, entry.name); if (entry.isDirectory()) { copyDir(srcPath, destPath); } else { fs.copyFileSync(srcPath, destPath); } } } if (fs.existsSync('out')) { copyDir('out', 'dist'); console.log('Copied out/ to dist/'); }"
